concepts.name: Exponential Function
concepts.simple_definition: An exponential function has the form f(x) = a^x where base a > 0 and a ≠ 1.
concepts.deep_explanation: The domain is all real numbers R, and the range is all positive real numbers (0, ∞). It has a horizontal asymptote at y = 0.
concepts.real_example: f(x) = 2^x represents exponential growth, doubling for each integer increase in x.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking f(x) = x² is an exponential function. In x², the variable is in the base, not the exponent.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ኤክስፖኔንሻል ፈንክሽን ማለት የf(x) = a^x ቅርጽ ያለው ፈንክሽን ሲሆን፣ መሠረቱ a > 0 እና a ≠ 1 ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ዶሜኑ ሁሉም እውነተኛ ቁጥሮች (R) ሲሆኑ፣ ሬንጁ ደግሞ አወንታዊ እውነተኛ ቁጥሮች (0, ∞) ናቸው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: f(x) = 2^x የኤክስፖኔንሻል ዕድገት ፈንክሽን ሲሆን በየጊዜው እጥፍ የሚሆን እሴትን ያሳያል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: f(x) = x² ኤክስፖኔንሻል ፈንክሽን ነው ብሎ ማሰብ። በx² ውስጥ ተለዋዋጩ መሠረቱ ላይ እንጂ ገላጩ ላይ አይደለም።
